title: A Parish for the Confession
author: Ada Okonkwo
blurb: Petra Blackwood, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the statute expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
